The new solid stick deodorant seemed too good to be true, so I truthfully didn’t think it would work as well as the cream formula. It actually works better. Keeps me scent-free for two days, whereas the cream needed a fresh application the next day.  I use the Warm Vanilla scent, which is more of a spiced unisex scent in the stick, while in the cream it was nice and sweet. I’ve noticed Lume doesn’t seem to like overtly

reviews.t: Stands up to being in quarantine
reviews.x: I have to quarantine and isolate for 10 days with Covid in Hawaii and admittedly haven’t taken a shower for the last 4 (or 5?) days because of feeling so crappy and sorry for myself. But I think this stuff is helping me not stink? Or maybe my mom who also has Covid has not mentioned it if I do. The deodorant has a nice, mild vanilla smell and I’ve been using it a few weeks now— I love that it doesn’t have aluminum. I might take a shower tomorrow but until then I’m thankful for this stuff 🤣

I like the scent of vanilla have not tried the others ,  It does need to be put on a 2nd time if working physically . But for running around and light work i think it is a great product , I have yet to put anywhere but under arms , but I would if needed , lol . I feel the product is a safe product glad to see it on the market.

I spent an entire day wearing this deodorant including activities that would make you sweat. Although it does work as a deodorant, I got burns from it! Definitely not a product for sensitive skin. Please be aware that this might happen if you try it. I would never recommend this product to anyone.

reviews.t: I've been using Lume for years and love this new product
reviews.x: Several years ago I stopped using traditional antiperspirant deodorants after my mom was diagnosed with inflammatory breast cancer and I was found to carry the gene. I've been using Lume due to sensitive skin and multiple chemical allergies on the T.R.U.E. allergy test performed by the immunologist. However, the original cream deodorant had to be applied 2x a day or I would start to stink halfway through the day. The new solid stick lasts all day. I love that the scent is mild and barely there.

I ordered this for my older teen who has been having an issue with body odor. She showers daily and faithfully uses deodorant but halfway through her day, her body odor would come back. She tried this deodorant and first I have to say, I love vanilla scented products and so does she, this smells like sweet BO to me and her. She has been using since it arrived and swears it wears off even faster than regular deodorant. Within 3 hours she smells like she hasn’t taken a shower and washed for days.

I do not like that this stick was about 2/3rds the size of a $4 stick of other deodorant. Smell was fine, but I can't get over the residue. After the first use it started clumping up around the opening of the stick, and after a week I couldn't even open it without getting it all over my hands. No I do not have that issue with any other brand. I also have never had my hands covered in residue just from a small scratch to the area. claims.text: Many reviewers say the deodorant actually works and controls body odor, often after other natural or aluminum-free brands failed.
Several reviewers report that it does not irritate their skin, unlike other deodorants they tried.
A few reviewers experienced skin irritation or a painful itchy rash after using it.
Some reviewers found the scent pleasant, while others were unimpressed or noticed a funky smell from the product itself.
A few reviewers said it did not control odor for them or that they smelled worse after using it.

qa.q: Does it actually work for whole-body odor?
qa.answer: Reviews are mixed on whole-body odor: some report it keeps all odor away across body areas [6] and stops body odor [1][3][4], but one reviewer was not confident and could smell themselves even while inactive [2].

claims.text: One reviewer reports it keeps all odor away and doesn't irritate skin anywhere, noting they perspire in many places beyond the underarms [6].
Other reviewers report it stops body odor and keeps them smelling fresh [1][3][4].
One reviewer was unsure, noticing a smell the next day while inactive and not confident to wear it to work [2].

qa.q: Is it safe for sensitive skin?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree: some report irritation or burns, while others say it did not irritate their sensitive skin. [1] says it burned them and is "definitely not a product for sensitive skin," but [2], [3], [4], [5], and [6] report no irritation or allergic reaction.

claims.text: One reviewer reports burns and says it is not for sensitive skin.
Other reviewers report no irritation or allergic reaction, including those with sensitive skin.

qa.q: Does the warm vanilla scent smell strong or artificial?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on the warm vanilla scent: some say it smells good or as expected [3][5], while others describe it as unpleasant, with one saying it smelled like BO [1] and another calling it only "okay, but not great" [2]. No review directly describes it as strong or artificial.

claims.text: One reviewer says the warm vanilla scent smells just as they thought warm vanilla would [3].
One reviewer says the scent smells good when you open it up [5].
One reviewer says it smelled like BO the moment the cap was off [1].
One reviewer says the vanilla scent is okay, but not great [2].

qa.q: How long does one stick last?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: Does it leave stains or residue on clothes?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree: one reviewer reports residue that clumps around the stick and gets on hands [5], while another notes clothes worn during work still stank even after washing [1]. No review directly confirms staining clothes.

claims.text: One reviewer reports residue that clumps around the stick opening and gets on hands [5].
Another reviewer reports clothes worn during work still stank even after washing [1].
